candidate: H34a shared separable row-column task-gradient conditioner leave-one-node-out discriminator
purpose: Test whether the relation between a procedural synthetic task atom and the dense leading update factors into shared hidden-channel and residual-channel fields that transfer to an untouched layer/role node.

task_atom.formula: D_n(E) = NS5(gradient of fixed task loss with respect to W_n at W0)

fit.target: six-node leading PC of the centered registered 239-state trajectory
fit.normalization: unit Frobenius norm independently for each canonicalized task atom and PC part
fit.algorithm: 20 deterministic alternating least-squares iterations over training-node coefficients, shared rows, then shared columns
fit.gauge: normalize left RMS to one after every iteration and compensate right
fit.heldout_score: squared cosine after the heldout node's optimal scalar coefficient

routing_after_pass: Preregister one exact-state tangent audit covering joint PCs, late updates, layer-6 A/B common path, and held-out innovation for the identical separable conditioner.
routing_after_failure: Close the exact shared separable channel conditioner and return to theory before selecting another ledger row.
